answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so even a strong history fades unless an identity provides sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil with no credible incoming endorsements has near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocal, transitive trust can raise that score only through established relationships, not a copied vine of aliases. Like a copper thread, each identity must earn durable support before it can influence consensus.
